title: IEANTN (Terence Tao): Riemann Zeta Analytic Machinery & Exponential Sums
description: Eight verbatim open analytic number theory theorems from Terence Tao's IEANTN (teorth/IEANTN@cd9c2dd3, Apache-2.0): Patel (2020) corrected Cheng–Graham exponential-sum Lemmas 2 & 3 and explicit |ζ(1 + it)| bound; the paired Hadamard partial-fraction expansion of ζ'/ζ; Rosser's Riemann–von Mangoldt zero-counting bounds; Trudgian (2011) Theorem 2.2 Turing-method integral bound on S(t); and Hiary (2016) critical-line subconvexity |ζ(1/2 + it)|.

tasks.title: Patel (2020) corrected Cheng–Graham Lemma 2 (1st-derivative exponential sum)
tasks.description: Prove `Patel2020.v1.cheng_graham_lemma_2`: explicit Kusmin–Landau / van der Corput first-derivative exponential sum bound ≤ (2/π) U.

tasks.title: Patel (2020) corrected Cheng–Graham Lemma 3 (2nd-derivative exponential sum)
tasks.description: Prove `Patel2020.v1.cheng_graham_lemma_3`: corrected explicit van der Corput second-derivative exponential sum bound.

tasks.title: Patel (2020): explicit |ζ(1 + it)| ≤ min(log t, ½ log t + 1.93, ⅕ log t + 44.02)
tasks.description: Prove `Patel2020.v1.zeta_one_bound` for all t ≥ 3 (may import verified `TaskChengGraham2` and `TaskChengGraham3`).

tasks.title: Hadamard partial-fraction expansion of ζ'/ζ (unconditional paired HasSum)
tasks.description: Prove `ZetaHadamard.v1.logDeriv_partial_fractions` (Montgomery–Vaughan Corollary 10.14 / Davenport §12 in paired HasSum form).

tasks.title: Rosser / Chirre–Helfgott Lemma B.1(a): |Q(t)| < 1 for 0 < t ≤ 280
tasks.description: Prove `ZeroCount.v1.rvm_error_small`: explicit Riemann–von Mangoldt zero-count remainder |N(t) - rvmMain(t)| < 1 on (0, 280].

tasks.title: Rosser / Chirre–Helfgott Lemma B.1(b): |Q(t)| ≤ (1/5) log t + 2 for t ≥ 1
tasks.description: Prove `ZeroCount.v1.rvm_error_bound`: explicit Riemann–von Mangoldt remainder bound for all t ≥ 1.

tasks.title: Trudgian (2011) Theorem 2.2: |∫_{t₁}^{t₂} S(t) dt| ≤ 2.067 + 0.059 log t₂
tasks.description: Prove `Trudgian2011.v1.integral_S_bound` for all t₂ > t₁ > 168π (Turing's method core bound).

tasks.title: Hiary (2016) corrected Theorem 1.1: |ζ(1/2 + it)| ≤ 0.77 t^{1/6} log t
tasks.description: Prove `Hiary2016.v1.zeta_half_line_bound` for all t ≥ 3 (explicit Weyl/van der Corput critical-line subconvexity).
